judge_reasoning: The model's solution does not use Pathmaker Initiate's unblockable-granting ability at all, instead simply attacking with all creatures. While total attacking power is 17, the opponent can optimally block (not blocking menace-having Kari Zev, and instead blocking the Angel, Glory-Bound Initiate, and either Ragavan or Pathmaker Initiate with their three blockers) to reduce damage to only 7, leaving the opponent alive at 3 life. This fails to guarantee a win against all blocking decisions, unlike the official solution which uses Pathmaker Initiate's ability (via Djeru's Resolve to reuse it) to make both Kari Zev and Ragavan explicitly unblockable, guaranteeing exactly 10 damage.
model_solution:
1. Cast Djeru's Resolve targeting Glory-Bound Initiate (untap it).
2. Cast Invocation of Saint Traft targeting Kari Zev, Skyship Raider.
3. Cast Consuming Fervor targeting Kari Zev, Skyship Raider.
4. Attack with Kari Zev, Pathmaker Initiate, and Glory-Bound Initiate (exert Glory-Bound Initiate).
